Sprinter, limo and party bus service in Scottsdale

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. Scottsdale is our home city and the bulk of our nightly work. We run Old Town bar and restaurant crawls, resort and golf transfers around Troon and DC Ranch, Kierland shopping and dinner runs, and airport transfers from every corner of the city — from South Scottsdale up through Pinnacle Peak.

Chauffeur service in Scottsdale

Old Town punishes anyone who tries to park on a Friday night. A chauffeur drops your group at the door of the Entertainment District, waits out of the way, and collects you at the same spot when you are done. Groups moving between the Waterfront, Fifth Avenue and Scottsdale Stadium keep one vehicle for the whole night rather than juggling rideshares.

Where we pick up in Scottsdale

We pick up at private residences, the airpark business district, Scottsdale Fashion Square, and resort porte-cocheres across Gainey Ranch, McCormick Ranch and the north Scottsdale communities. Old Town pickups are set at a named cross street rather than a crowded kerb, so the group and the chauffeur are never hunting for each other.

Frequently asked questions

Where do you pick up in Old Town Scottsdale on a busy night?

At a named cross street in the Entertainment District rather than a crowded kerb. Your chauffeur texts on arrival, waits off the main strip, and returns to the same spot each time your group moves between venues, so nobody is looking for a vehicle at midnight.

Can one vehicle cover a whole Scottsdale evening?

Yes, and it is the cheaper way to do it. Vehicles are booked by the hour with a published minimum, so a group can hold the same Sprinter for dinner in Old Town, a stop at the Waterfront and the ride home instead of paying for three separate trips.

Do you serve North Scottsdale resorts and golf courses?

Yes. We run transfers across the whole north of the city — the Kierland shopping district, the Troon and Pinnacle Peak corridor, DC Ranch and the communities around them — plus the airpark for private aviation arrivals.

How far ahead should a Scottsdale group book?

Availability varies by date and by vehicle. Request a current quote for your date and we confirm in writing what is open. Weeknight groups and short-notice requests are still worth asking about; the reservations team answers the same way, in writing, before anything is paid.
